scope: Current source-bound EARTH nuclear/UAP ledger versus the current public POSS-I SPACE cohort, with explicit temporal and representation controls.

current_matches.meaning: The Pantex event cannot be exact-day joined to POSS-I because it occurs decades after the frozen Palomar cohort.
Pilgrim is outside the POSS-I window and its document-level transcription remains below primary-byte authority.
Los Alamos is historically close to the POSS-I era, but a year-only row has no right to an exact-day join.
current_matches.unlock: Bind exact contemporaneous event/conference dates from primary records before comparing to Palomar observation days.

current_matches.meaning: Modern AARO nuclear-site UAS counts are reporting aggregates, not day-level physical-event rows.

space_controls_already_survived.schedule_identity: ANY_CANDIDATE == PALOMAR_OBSERVED_NIGHT in the dense S0 cohort
space_controls_already_survived.detector_warning: An astrometric defect on 8 repaired tiles created 12,273 false-survivor rows and left only 30 after repair on those tiles.
space_controls_already_survived.field_density_warning: Candidate density is strongly sky-position dependent.
space_controls_already_survived.independent_digitization_warning: SuperCOSMOS disagrees with roughly two fifths of the compact S0 catalogue according to the bound SPACE control row.

new_observer_autosync_contract.earth: Scan Janus-Cosmos plus public JANUS Meta Registry JSON for explicit latitude/longitude pairs and registry-resolved named sites.
new_observer_autosync_contract.space: Scan explicit RA/Dec pairs separately and layer them over the public 642-center POSS-I survey manifest.
new_observer_autosync_contract.unmapped: Preserve source rows with unresolved coordinates instead of silently dropping them.
new_observer_autosync_contract.schedule: GitHub Pages rebuild every six hours plus source pushes/manual dispatch.

blocking_gate.reason: The current compact public plate manifest carries angular plate centers but not observation dates; the day-level denominator must be source-bound from plate/tile metadata before exact joins are allowed.

epistemic_ceiling: CURRENT DATA SUPPORT SOURCE-BOUND EVENTS, NULL TEMPORAL OVERLAPS, REPORTING-PIPELINE CONTROLS AND A PUBLIC PALOMAR NULL/NO-ROBUST-POSITIVE-RESIDUAL RESULT. THEY DO NOT ESTABLISH NUCLEAR ATTRACTION, NONHUMAN ORIGIN OR CROSS-DOMAIN CAUSATION.
next_actions: Materialize the 312 Palomar observation-day rows from source-bound plate/tile metadata.
Bind exact dates for historical Los Alamos case-family rows.
Continue NRC RG615 primary-byte binding and reporting-regime timeline.
Let the autosync index surface every newly added explicit Earth or sky coordinate without hand-editing the visualization.
canonical_seal: FIRST MAKE THE MAP COMPLETE; THEN MAKE THE JOIN LEGAL. A POINT MAY BE DISCOVERED AUTOMATICALLY, BUT A CAUSAL CLAIM MAY NOT.
